listing.name: Perfect Dark (Xbox Live Arcade remaster) — Perfect Dark Remaster Recompilation (nikolaygorb)
listing.summary: The project reports D3D12 boot, audio and input, plus mission-restart fixes. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own complete extracted Perfect Dark (Xbox Live Arcade remaster) Xbox 360 game files, including the original executable. The XBLA title is 584109C2. The README also gives a conflicting Xbox One ISO instruction; the accepted input remains unresolved. Check with the project before preparing a copy.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Build SDK submodule and Windows target; README source instructions confusingly also mention an Xbox One ISO.

warnings: The project reports D3D12 boot, audio and input, plus mission-restart fixes.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
